# Studio-Branding zur Laufzeit: sva-studio (Standard) oder kassel-dialog
SVA_STUDIO_BRANDING=sva-studio

# ============================================================================
# Redis Configuration
# ============================================================================

# Standard Redis connection string (unencrypted for local development)
# REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379

# TLS-enabled Redis connection string (production recommended)
# REDIS_URL=rediss://localhost:6380

# Enable/disable TLS for Redis (automatically detected from REDIS_URL if starts with rediss://)
# TLS_ENABLED=true

# Paths to TLS certificates (optional, defaults to ./dev/redis-tls/ for development)
# REDIS_CA_PATH=/path/to/ca.pem
# REDIS_CERT_PATH=/path/to/redis.pem
# REDIS_KEY_PATH=/path/to/redis-key.pem

# ============================================================================
# Authentication (if using Redis ACL)
# ============================================================================

# Redis username (optional, requires Redis 6+)
# For session store with minimal permissions:
#   ACL SETUSER sessions on '>password' ~'session:*' ~'login_state:*' '+@read' '+@write' '+@keyspace'
# REDIS_USERNAME=sessions

# Redis password (optional, use with ACL for enhanced security)
# Set during ACL user creation with: ACL SETUSER sessions on '>password'
# REDIS_PASSWORD=sva-secure-password-2026

# ============================================================================
# Session Configuration
# ============================================================================

# Session TTL in seconds (default: 604800 = 7 days)
# SESSION_TTL=604800

# ============================================================================
# Token Encryption (AES-256-GCM)
# ============================================================================

# Base64-encoded 32-byte encryption key for token-at-rest encryption
# Generate with: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('base64'))"
# ENCRYPTION_KEY=your-base64-encoded-32-byte-key

# Optional: Enable encryption for sensitive tokens (accessToken, refreshToken, idToken)
# When not set, tokens are stored unencrypted (not recommended for production)
# ENCRYPT_TOKENS=true

# ============================================================================
# OAuth/Keycloak Configuration
# ============================================================================

# Keycloak realm and client details
# KEYCLOAK_REALM=your-realm
# KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID=your-client-id
# KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET=your-client-secret

# Keycloak Admin API Service Account (for IAM user management backend)
# IMPORTANT: KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET must be injected via secrets manager in production.
# KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_BASE_URL=https://keycloak.example.com
# KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_REALM=your-realm
# KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID=sva-studio-iam-service
# KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_SECRET=injected-via-secrets-manager

# IAM Feature Flags
# IAM_UI_ENABLED=true
# IAM_ADMIN_ENABLED=true
# IAM_BULK_ENABLED=false

# PII-Verschlüsselung (Standard: in production fail-closed, in dev/test Fallback erlaubt)
# IAM_PII_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT_FALLBACK=false

# Optional: Zusätzliche erlaubte Origins für CSRF-Validierung (Comma-separated)
# IAM_CSRF_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://admin.example.com,https://studio.example.com

# ============================================================================
# Postgres Configuration (IAM Core Data Layer)
# ============================================================================

# Lokale Postgres-Zugangsdaten für Docker Compose
# POSTGRES_DB=sva_studio
# POSTGRES_USER=sva
# POSTGRES_PASSWORD=sva_local_dev_password

# Applikationsverbindung für den IAM Core Data Layer
# IAM_DATABASE_URL=postgres://sva_app:sva_app_local_dev_password@localhost:5432/sva_studio

# ============================================================================
# Development Notes
# ============================================================================

# Generate TLS certificates locally:
#   cd dev/redis-tls
#   openssl genrsa -out ca-key.pem 2048
#   openssl req -new -x509 -days 365 -key ca-key.pem -out ca.pem -subj "/CN=Redis-CA"
